bioParagraphs: I'm drawn to the point where mathematics meets computing, where abstract theory turns into algorithms that actually solve problems. I like working on projects that sit at that intersection: designing efficient algorithms, building computational models, or digging into data to find patterns that matter. What excites me most is taking a mathematical idea and shaping it into something that runs, scales, and holds up in the real world.

Lately I've been focused on low-latency systems, the kind of engineering where every microsecond counts. I'm exploring how new algorithms and machine learning techniques can be integrated into systems engineering to push performance further, without sacrificing reliability.
